episodes.ep-02.md: Lin leaves for Master Gu's workshop. Master Gu keeps the authentic LQ-17 shard in a locked cedar box. Lin carries only a harmless replica shard.
episodes.ep-03.md: Lin opens her palm and presses the authentic LQ-17 shard she has carried since the donor vault. The inner petal opens. 【本集钩子】The opened petal is in Lin's hand.
episodes.ep-04.md: Lin enters rehearsal holding the opened inner petal from episode 3.
